messages:
Nina (PM): AcmeCorp escalation: they require tenant-level telemetry export for pilot (S3 + syslog). Ask from sales is: include in MVP for pilot tenants or mark as v1 and offer manual workaround? Need a decision to lock milestone board.

Diego (Eng): Implementing export is small feature-wise but touches KMS/ACLs, retention, and e2e tests. Roughly 1 sprint to make product-safe. Quick alternative: manual ops push to staging bucket for pilot (~3 days).

Priya (Legal): Legal will need a DPA addendum for logs and PII filtering. We can prioritize review but it will take 3-5 business days. If pilot-only, we can scope the DPA narrowly.

Kevin (Sales): AcmeCorp made this a gating item for the pilot. They'll accept "pilot-only, opt-in" with explicit retention 30 days. They need a written pledge today.

Ravi (Infra): Operations: per-tenant export increases egress/storage. For a single pilot we can provision staging infra + short-lived creds. Recommend opt-in default off, throttling, and billing meter.

Diego (Eng): Proposed MVP plan:
```
feature: tenant_telemetry_export
opt_in: true
retention_days_default: 30
rate_limit_per_tenant: 10MBps
audit_log: enabled
```
Will add an emergency kill-switch and canary to single region.

Nina (PM): Trade-off: pulling Eng for 1 sprint delays embeddings-cache and rollout automation. But losing pilot costs more. My proposal: ship as MVP pilot-only opt-in, gated behind legal DPA and infra throttles. If gates miss, fall back to manual ops.

Priya (Legal): I'll start DPA draft now. Need full feature spec and retention defaults.

Kevin (Sales): I'll push the pilot-limited contract clause to Acme and request immediate sign-off.

Ravi (Infra): I'll provision staging bucket with KMS and meter export bytes. Also add alert if export rates exceed 80% of provisioned egress.

milestone-bot: Milestone updated: "Pilot telemetry export (opt-in)" -> MVP candidate. Owner: Nina. ETA: +7 days.

Diego (Eng): I'll scope the sprint tasks and open PR with flags & smoke tests (ACL/arrival/retention).

Nina (PM): Decision recorded: MVP pilot-only opt-in with strict gates: DPA signed, opt-in default off, infra throttles/billing, kill-switch. If any gate fails revert to manual export and keep feature in v1 backlog. Closing unless blockers.

Kevin (Sales): :thumbsup: I'll update Acme and post signature here.

Diego (Eng): Quick ask : please confirm which team owns monitoring dashboard for exported bytes.

Ravi (Infra): Infra will own the export meter and dashboard; will handoff to Observability after pilot.
